examples.text: nissitassa calitaṃ, anissitassa calitaṃ n'atthi. calite asati passaddhi, passaddhiyā sati nati na hoti. natiyā asati āgatigati na hoti. āgatigatiyā asati cut'ūpapāto na hoti. cut'ūpapāte asati n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.
katame ca, bhikkhave, dhammā cakkhunā sacchikaraṇīyā? sattānaṃ cut'ūpapāto, bhikkhave, cakkhunā sacchikaraṇīyo.

26903.commentary: (DNa) cut'ūpapātañāṇaṃ cutipaṭisandhicchādakaṃ tamaṃ vijjhati, tañ'ca viditaṃ karotī'ti vijjā.

examples.text: sattānaṃ cut'ūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti

26904.meaning1: teaching about the knowledge of death and rebirth

26905.commentary: (ADHa) cut'ūpapāte ñāṇan'ti cutiyañ'ca upapāte ca ñāṇaṃ. idam'pi sattānaṃ cutipaṭisandhicchādakaṃ tamaṃ vijjhatī'ti vijjā. taṃ tamaṃ vijjhitvā sattānaṃ cutipaṭisandhiyo viditā pākaṭā karotī'ti viditakaraṇ'aṭṭhenā'pi vijjā.

examples.text: tisso vijjā, pubbenivās'ānussatiñāṇaṃ vijjā, sattānaṃ cut'ūpapāteñāṇaṃ vijjā, āsavānaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ vijjā.
kati chinde kati jahe, kati c'uttari bhāvaye, kati saṅg'ātigo bhikkhu, oghatiṇṇo'ti vuccatī'ti.

26907.commentary: (THIa) uppalaṃ c'udakā samuggatan'ti ca-kāro nipātamattaṃ, udakato uggataṃ uṭṭhitaṃ accuggamma ṭhitaṃ suphullam'uppalaṃ.

examples.text: uppalaṃ c'udakā samuggataṃ, yathā taṃ amanussasevitaṃ, evaṃ tvaṃ brahmacārinī, sakes'aṅgesu jaraṃ gamissasi.
cudito vacībhi satim'ābhinande, sabrahmacārīsu khilaṃ pabhinde, vācaṃ pamuñce kusalaṃ n'ātivelaṃ, janavādadhammāya na cetayeyya.
cuddasa kho pan'imāni yonipamukhasatasahassāni saṭṭhi ca satāni cha ca satāni, pañca ca kammuno satāni pañca ca kammāni tīṇi ca kammāni, kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca
cuddasakāy'ānupassanā niṭṭhitā.
cuddasamasikkhāpadaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

yā imā, cunda, anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti, attavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā lokavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā, yattha c'etā diṭṭhiyo uppajjanti yattha ca anusenti yattha ca samudācaranti taṃ n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na me so attā'ti

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena pāvā tadavasari. tatra sudaṃ bhagavā pāvāyaṃ viharati cundassa kammāraputtassa ambavane. assosi kho cundo kammāraputto, bhagavā kira pāvaṃ anuppatto, pāvāyaṃ viharati mayhaṃ ambavane'ti.

26921.commentary: (UDa) āmantayi cundakan'ti tasmiṃ kira khaṇe āyasmā ānando udakasāṭikaṃ pīḷento ohīyi, cundakatthero samīpe ahosi. tasmā taṃ bhagavā āmantayi.

examples.text: nhatvā ca pivitvā c'udatāri satthā, purakkhato bhikkhugaṇassa majjhe, satthā pavattā bhagavā idha dhamme, upāgami ambavanaṃ mahesi, āmantayi cundakaṃ nāma bhikkhuṃ, catugguṇaṃ santhara me nipajjaṃ.

atha kho cundī rājakumārī pañcahi rathasatehi pañcahi ca kumārisatehi parivutā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho cundī rājakumārī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

26930.meaning1: cloth pad worn on the head for carrying heavy loads
26930.commentary: (VINa) obhaṭaṃ oropitaṃ cumbaṭam'assā'ti obhaṭacumbaṭā, kaṭṭhahārik'ādīnaṃ aññatarā, yassā sīsato cumbaṭaṃ oropetvā ghare vāseti, tassā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: obhaṭacumbaṭā nāma cumbaṭaṃ oropetvā vāseti.

26932.commentary: (JAa) kīḷatī'ti sayaṃ vā kīḷati, dārakaṃ vā kīḷāpeti. cumban'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: cattālīsāya khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, ṭhānehi itthī purisaṃ accācarati. vijambhati, vinamati, vilasati, vilajjati, nakhena nakhaṃ ghaṭṭeti, pādena pādaṃ akkamati, kaṭṭhena pathaviṃ vilikhati, dārakaṃ ullaṅghati ullaṅghāpeti, kīḷati kīḷāpeti, cumbati cumbāpeti, bhuñjati bhuñjāpeti, dadāti…

26944.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in creating a mind-made body; foremost monk among those skilled in the expansion of mind
26944.commentary: (UDa) cūḷapanthako'ti mahāpanthakattherassa kaniṭṭhabhātikattā panthe jātattā ca daharakāle laddhavohārena aparabhāge'pi ayam'āyasmā cūḷapanthako'tv'eva paññāyittha. guṇavisesehi pana chaḷabhiñño pabhinnapaṭisambhido etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminantānaṃ yadidaṃ cūḷapanthako, cetovivaṭṭakusalānaṃ yadidaṃ cūḷapanthako'ti dvīsu (a. ni. 1.199) ṭhānesu bhagavatā etadagge ṭhapito asītiyā mahāsāvakesu abbhantaro.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminantānaṃ yadidaṃ cullapanthako.
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā cullapanthako bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.

satta devā, satta mānusā, satta pesācā, satta sarā, satta pavuṭā, satta papātā, satta papātasatāni, satta supinā, satta supinasatāni, cullāsīti mahākappino satasahassāni, yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti.
amma jīvā'ti vanamhi kandasi, attānaṃ adhigaccha ubbiri, cullāsītisahassāni, sabbā jīvasanāmikā, etamh'āḷāhane daḍḍhā, tāsaṃ kam'anusocasi.
yassa sakkariyamānassa, asakkārena c'ūbhayaṃ, samādhi na vikampati, appamādavihārino.
pahānaṃ kāmacchandānaṃ, domanassāna c'ūbhayaṃ, thinassa ca panūdanaṃ, kukkuccānaṃ nivāraṇaṃ.
atha kho cūḷakokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ mahāvanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
kataññunā me bhavituṃ vaṭṭatī'ti ekaṃ satasahassaṃ gāhāpetvā cūḷaseṭṭhissa samīpaṃ gato

26972.commentary: (ANa) cūḷanikā'ti khuddikā. ayaṃ sāvakānaṃ visayo. kasmā pan'esā ānītā'ti? majjhimikāya lokadhātuyā paricchedadassan'atthaṃ. (NIDD1a) sahassim'pi cūḷanikan'ti ettha yāvatā candimasūriyā pariharanti, disā bhānti virocamānā, tāva sahassadhā loko, esā sahassicūḷanikā nāma. cūḷanikan'ti khuddakaṃ.

examples.text: yāvat'ānanda, sahassī cūḷanikā lokadhātu tāva sahassadhā loko. ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, dvisahassī majjhimikā lokadhātu.

ākaṅkhamāno ca bhagavā ekam'pi lokadhātuṃ passeyya, dve'pi lokadhātuyo passeyya… satam'pi lokadhātuyo passeyya, sahassim'pi cūḷanikaṃ lokadhātuṃ passeyya, dvisahassim'pi majjhimikaṃ lokadhātuṃ passeyya, tisahassim'pi lokadhātuṃ passeyya, mahāsahassim'pi lokadhātuṃ passeyya.
yo rājā cūḷanīputto, pañcālānaṃ rath'esabho, taṃ bhante anusocāmi, bhattāraṃ sabbakāmadan'ti.

26976.notes: Theragāthā verses 557-566 (TH10.4, TH236) are attributed to him.

examples.text: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ cūḷapanthakaṃ avidūre nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminantānaṃ yadidaṃ cūḷapanthako.
aparesam'pi dasannaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, jeṭṭhabhātu, kaniṭṭhabhātu, jeṭṭhabhaginiyā, kaniṭṭhabhaginiyā, cūḷamātuyā, mahāmātuyā, cūḷapituno, mahāpituno, pitucchāya, mātulassā'ti.
